name: Alice
text:
Fwd: Kiln booking
The kiln is out of action until the element is swapped. Your Thursday firing moves to the small kiln at the annex.
Thanks,
Alice

name: Chantziaras
text:
Forwarded from the print room
The paper order was short again and the gloss stock is down to one box. We are rationing the colour runs until the pallet lands on Tuesday. The guillotine needs a new clamp pad.
Regards,
Chantziaras

name: Prötel Ferraina
text:
Fwd: Boat hoist
The travel lift passed its inspection with two advisory notes about the sling wear. The slings are being replaced next month and the yard will run on the smaller hoist until then. Boats over eight metres need to book the crane instead.
Thanks,
Prötel Ferraina

name: Mysliwiec Ahmed Wachholz
text:
Fwd: Key audit
The cabinet keys were audited and two spares are missing. Replacements get cut Saturday.
Thanks,
Mysliwiec Ahmed Wachholz

name: Sivamoorthy
text:
Forwarded from the ticket desk
The matinee on Saturday is nearly sold out and the balcony rail needs a fresh paint touch up before then. We have moved the box office queue indoors to the foyer.
Regards,
Sivamoorthy

name: Lucantonio
text:
Fwd: Alley lighting
The two lights behind the bins have been dark since the storm and the walkway is unsafe after six. The electrician traced a water ingress in the junction box and has ordered a gasket set. Until the fix lands, the marshals will walk groups through with torches.
Thanks,
Lucantonio

name: Schieck Grassioulet Mandundu
text:
Fwd: Soil tests
The lead readings came back inside the limit for all four beds. The vegetable plot is cleared to reopen Monday.
Thanks,
Schieck Grassioulet Mandundu

name: Hobbs-Ray Leefsma
text:
Forwarded from the museum office
The loan agreement for the coin case came back signed and the display case is booked for collection on the 18th. Please log the courier details in the register when they arrive.
Regards,
Hobbs-Ray Leefsma

name: Jorinda
text:
Fwd: Chimney sweep
The sweep found a cracked flue tile on the west stack and a nest cap that has come loose. No fires until the tile is swapped, so the lounge hearth stays cold this week. The builder has matched the tile and the scaffold goes up Thursday.
Thanks,
Jorinda

name: Dilekçi
text:
Fwd: Boiler room
The pressure gauge was reading low and the top up was done. Watch the needle for the next few days.
Thanks,
Dilekçi

name: Deren Buxbaum
text:
Forwarded from the kennels
The vet visit for the rescues is booked for Thursday morning. The travel crates are stacked in the feed room and two need fresh latches. Keep the side gate shut on the day so the runs stay calm.
Regards,
Deren Buxbaum

name: Khabat Mendrit
text:
Fwd: Studio schedule
The shoot for the autumn catalogue moved to the week of the 8th because the photographer is on a course. The set build now starts a day earlier, so the paint shop needs the flats primed by Friday. The prop list is pinned in the workshop and anything missing should be flagged today.
Thanks,
Khabat Mendrit

name: Annelin
text:
Garden club
Winter talks confirmed for the 4th and 18th, both in the village hall.
The seed order goes in Friday.
Thanks,
Annelin

name: Essabbai
text:
Ward round
Two beds were swapped after the admissions and the charts were moved with the patients.
The pharmacy delivery came up short on two lines, repeats are ordered.
Physio hours change to afternoons from Monday.
Thanks,
Essabbai

name: Salvagno D'espine
text:
Security review
The gate fob audit closed with four missing tags, all deactivated at the panel.
Two cameras on the south fence were realigned and the recorder was swapped to a larger drive.
The patrol route now covers the fuel bay every hour.
Badge prints for contractors move to the front office.
Thanks,
Salvagno D'espine

name: Di Bonito
text:
Plot holders
Compost bays turned and the path was re edged.
Water butts are full again after the rain.
Two taps still drip, reported.
Thanks,
Di Bonito

name: Cabdinasir
text:
Transport meeting
The school run driver shortage is covered for two weeks by the depot pool.
Route 4 gets an extra stop at the library from Monday.
The bus pass renewals are due and the office has the forms.
Thanks,
Cabdinasir

name: Terracini
text:
Allotment committee
Plotholder list was updated and two half plots merged at the top field.
The hedge cutting contractor is booked for the second weekend and the cuttings pile is cleared for burning.
Water rates are unchanged this year, invoices go out next week.
The gate lock was changed and keys are with the secretary.
Thanks,
Terracini

name: de Loyola
text:
Library volunteers
Shelving shift ran late and the returns trolley was cleared.
The reading room reopens Tuesday.
The new mats arrived for the foyer.
Thanks,
de Loyola

name: Som Miri
text:
Kitchen deep clean
Fryer oil changed and the filters were swapped ahead of the inspection.
Walk in shelves were pulled out and the seals wiped.
The floor got a second pass after the drains were flushed.
Thanks,
Som Miri

name: Eriol
text:
Scout hut maintenance
Gutters were cleared on the west side and the downpipe was re seated.
The noticeboard was rehung with new hinges and the spare keys are back in the box.
Two tables need sanding and the paint is in the shed.
The minibus servicing is booked for the last week of the month.
Thanks,
Eriol

name: Verploegh
text:
Canteen crew
The soup urn was descaled and the tray rail was tightened.
Fridge temps all logged.
New menus go up Thursday.
Thanks,
Verploegh

name: Zojë Alexe
text:
Playgroup handover
The soft mats were wiped and the spare clothes box is full again.
Two families rebooked for the afternoon session and the register was updated.
The radiator guard is loose at one corner and is taped pending the fix.
Thanks,
Zojë Alexe

name: de Gregorio Buenrostro
text:
Residents meeting
Bin store rota is up and the new locks were fitted to both doors.
The visitor parking trial runs another month before a vote.
Two leaks in the undercroft were traced to the plant room and the plumber returns Friday.
The garden party date is set for the 26th.
Thanks,
de Gregorio Buenrostro

name: Liwam
text: Liwam, see the note from the allotment below. The shed window was broken again overnight and the tools got wet. The glazier comes Monday.

name: Brescancin
text: Brescancin, this came in from the marina office. The berth fees are due on the 1st and the gate cards need renewing at the same time. The pump out key is moving to the office wall, so return the old one.

name: Jonina Batke
text: Jonina Batke passed this on from the water team. The reservoir drawdown starts Monday and the river gauge will drop about a foot through the week. Anglers have been told at the hut and the signs are up at both slipways. The ecology check runs Wednesday and the pumps restart Friday if the reading allows.

name: Malda Goda
text: Malda Goda, forwarding the note from the gym desk. The pool lane booking moved to 7 am on weekdays and the sauna reopens Thursday.

name: Oriano
text: Oriano, see the note from the yard below. The forklift is due its service on Thursday so the morning loads go out on the pallet truck. The battery bank is being swapped the same day, so keep the spare charged.

name: Speil-Ehrenreich
text: Speil-Ehrenreich sent this over from the freight office. The pallet rates change on the 1st and the quote sheet is pinned by the scale. Two shipments from last month are still awaiting customs and the brokerage has the paperwork. Anything going over the water needs booking three days ahead now.

name: Laux Fabing
text: Laux Fabing forwarded the note from the records room. The deed boxes move to the basement on Friday and the catalogue is being reindexed.

name: Stasa Verazzo
text: Stasa Verazzo, passing on the message from the harbourmaster. The dredging barge arrives Tuesday and the slipway closes for three days. Dinghies move to the west rack and the crane bookings shift to the following week.

name: Ionut-Florin
text: Ionut-Florin, this is the note from the seed store. The pea and bean stock is back in and the onion sets land Friday. The potting bench order closes Tuesday, and anything after that rolls to the autumn list. The seed swap table needs a volunteer for the morning shift.

name: Bauta
text: Bauta, see the depot note below. The van goes for its MOT Wednesday and the courtesy car is booked for the same day.

name: Van Dyke
text: Van Dyke, passing on the note from the festivals office. The stall pitch list is final and the power drop for each row is on the map. Vendors arrive from seven and the gate steward has the passes.

name: Sevdush Ratan
text: Sevdush Ratan forwarded this from the bridge club. The duplicate night moves to the church hall while the sports pavilion has its floor refinished, and the boards are stored in the cupboard by the stage. The scoring software was updated and the old password no longer works. Table fees stay at three pounds.

name: Ginat
text: Ginat, the note from the tool store is below. The bandsaw blade order went in and the spare keys cut yesterday are in the tin.

name: Raeto
text: Raeto opened the meeting with the water damage claim and the insurers have agreed the scope. The drying equipment comes out Friday and the redecorating quote is due next week. The committee approved the deposit for the hall hire.

name: Gautschi
text: Gautschi took the minutes. The volunteer rota for the summer fete is full except for the tombola stall, and the prize donations are coming in slowly. The marquee quote was accepted and the deposit is paid. Setting up starts at eight on the day and the car park closes to visitors.

name: Gruszka Arrigucci
text: Gruszka Arrigucci ran the session. The pool cover replacement is approved and the order goes in Monday. Lane fees stay the same.

name: Enlil Cikar
text: Enlil Cikar called the meeting to order and the roof fund total was read out. The quiz night brought in more than expected and the shortfall is now covered. Tenders for the repointing go out next month.

name: Priscillah
text: Priscillah opened the briefing and the depot move was the first item. The new unit on the industrial estate clears its fit out on the 14th, so packing starts the following Monday. Deliveries route through the old yard until then and the last despatch is booked for Friday. The keys get handed over at noon.

name: Truppa
text: Truppa chaired the meeting. The lift maintenance contract was renewed for two years and the inspection dates are unchanged. Notices go up in the lobby.

name: Pichaya Berevan Llona
text: Pichaya Berevan Llona opened the session with the kitchen refit timeline. The units arrive in two drops and the water stays on until the second one. The cookery classes move to the annex hall for three weeks.

name: Ruca Mohanned
text: Ruca Mohanned took the notes. The trail marker posts have been ordered and the volunteers start fitting them the weekend after next. The bridge repair on the lower loop is waiting on the timber delivery, expected in a fortnight. Guided walks continue on the upper loop as usual.

name: Lobélia
text: Lobélia ran the wash up. The loos were restocked and the paper order went in early. Two taps are dripping again.

name: Howlett
text: Howlett called the meeting to order and the seasonal pitch fees were agreed. The council wants the hedge cut back from the footpath before the end of the month. The keeper has the tractor booked for the weekend.

name: Anjeli Lemar
text: Anjeli Lemar opened the year group meeting with the trip budget. The coaches are booked and the deposit clears on Friday, leaving the balance due before half term. Two parents volunteered for the kit washing rota. The consent forms go out next week. The pupil list closes at the end of the month.

name: de Quina
text: de Quina chaired the session. The telescope evenings resume on the 5th and the new eyepiece is in the cabinet. Bring red torches.

name: Dumitra
text: Dumitra opened the meeting with the battery recycling scheme and the first pickup is booked for the 9th. Bins go by the loading door with the lids taped shut. Posters for the staff room are printed.
